# Kyntlo

> Kyntlo is an AI growth operations platform for small and mid-sized service
> businesses. It replaces a fragmented stack — CRM, booking, website, email,
> SMS, reviews, payments — with one system, and adds AI agents that answer
> calls and messages, book appointments, send reminders and invoices, request
> reviews, and win back customers who have gone quiet.

One login. One invoice. One system that answers, books, bills, and follows up
whether or not anyone on the team is awake.

- Website: https://kyntlo.ai
- Customer workspace: https://hub.kyntlo.ai
- Support: Support@kyntlo.ai
- Company: Kyntlo for Artificial Intelligence Tools
- Category: AI Growth Operations

## Who it is for

Owner-operated and multi-site service businesses, typically 2–50 staff:
medical and dental clinics, med spas, salons and spas, home services
(plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, cleaning), fitness studios and gyms,
restaurants, auto repair, pet services, real estate teams, law firms, and
marketing agencies.

Kyntlo is a poor fit for pre-revenue startups, pure e-commerce with no
bookings or calls, and enterprises requiring deep custom integration and SSO.

## What it does — six systems

1. **Capture** — nothing arrives without being caught. Funnels and websites,
   forms and surveys, chat widget, missed-call text-back, unified inbox,
   contact records, ad manager.
2. **Respond** — something intelligent answers in seconds, on any channel, at
   any hour. AI voice agent, AI chat assistant, AI speed-to-lead.
3. **Convert** — intent becomes a confirmed, paid appointment. Calendars and
   smart booking, AI appointment booking, pipelines, payments and invoicing.
4. **Retain** — the customer returns without a human chasing them. AI
   reactivation, memberships and courses, communities, workflow automation.
5. **Amplify** — the business becomes visible and trusted. Reputation
   management, AI review responder, social planner, AI content and image
   generation.
6. **See** — the owner knows what worked and what it cost. Reporting
   dashboard, AI call insights, AI workflow builder.

## Autonomous AI agents

- **AI Voice Agent** — answers or places phone calls, holds a natural
  conversation, captures details, answers questions, checks real availability,
  books the appointment, transfers to a human when needed, and writes a call
  summary. Available in Arabic and English on the same number.
- **AI Chat Assistant** — replies across web chat, Instagram, Facebook,
  WhatsApp and SMS, typically within about 40 seconds, and hands off to a
  person when a question falls outside what it was trained on.
- **AI Speed-to-Lead** — detects a new enquiry from any source and starts a
  personalised follow-up immediately, then routes the lead toward booking.
- **AI Reactivation** — finds dormant customers and opens a contextual
  conversation referencing their last service.

Every agent discloses that it is an AI at the start of the conversation, has
defined escalation rules to a human, and is tested end to end with the client
before it goes live.

## Onboarding

1. **Growth Audit** — a 30-minute diagnostic call and a written two-page
   finding that quantifies where enquiries are being lost, in money. No demo,
   no obligation.
2. **Build** — Kyntlo configures the account, connects the channels, builds
   the workflows, trains the AI on the business, writes the messages, and
   tests end to end before go-live. Typically $500–$2,500 one time depending
   on scope.
3. **Go-live** — target is under 14 days from signature to the first
   automated booking, reply or payment.
4. **Day 30 review** — results reviewed against the original audit.

The client does not set the system up themselves. That is the point of the
build fee.

## Support after launch

Ongoing support from the Kyntlo team, included with every plan. Optional
Managed Growth retainers cover campaign execution, ads, content and monthly
optimisation.

## Pricing

Plans are billed monthly or quarterly, in USD, and exclude taxes. A 14-day
free trial applies to every standard plan; the card is charged when the trial
ends, not on the day of signup. Month to month, cancel any time, data
exportable at any point.

| Plan | Monthly | For |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | $90 | CRM, booking and lead capture for a small team getting organised |
| Growth | $270 | Multiple pipelines, omnichannel inbox and workflow automation |
| Pro | $490 | The full AI layer — voice, chat, reviews, reactivation, reporting |
| Customized | Quoted | Choose your own features, limits and services |

Quarterly billing currently carries a launch promotion of 50% off the first
quarter, which is why the site shows "from $45". The plan renews at the list
price above once that first quarter ends.

Usage — messages, call minutes and AI — is billed on top of the plan at
published rates. Every rate charged appears on the pricing page. Examples:
email $1.36 per 1,000; outbound SMS (US) $24.90 per 1,000 segments; outbound
calls $0.03 per minute; Conversation AI $8.00 per 1,000 exchanges; call
transcription $0.048 per minute. WhatsApp rates are set by Meta and vary by
country. Most small teams spend $15–$60 a month on usage.

## What Kyntlo replaces

A typical stack of twelve tools — CRM, funnels, website, forms, email
marketing, SMS, booking, workflow automation, reputation management, courses,
chat widget, call tracking — runs between $809 and $3,295 a month depending
on the tier of each tool, or about $2,052 for a typical mid-range
configuration, across twelve vendors, twelve logins and twelve invoices.
Kyntlo starts at $90. The per-category breakdown behind that figure is
published on the homepage.

## Data and compliance

Client data is exportable and erasable by the client at any time, encrypted in
transit and at rest, and GDPR-aligned. Kyntlo does not sell or share client
customer lists, and does not train models on them. Review requests are sent to
every customer, never only to satisfied ones.
